review.evidence: Fresh conversation invoked strictly from .keeper-brief.md with zero access to the shaping or repair conversation; audited on-disk .skeinn/ artifacts, Skeinn CLI outputs (keeper prompt, context --keeper, task next, check), GitHub issues (Haaaiawd/Utopinn), and actual source/test files across packages/core/, apps/server/, apps/cli/, and apps/web/ in read-only mode.

summary: Significant progress since attempt 2: 5 of 7 prior gaps are verified closed (PROJECT.md/STRUCTURE.md aligned to V2 truth, theater extra.choices reconciled across docs and tasks, distribution-forms compiled into v2-stack-decisions.md and admin-surface.md, core-engine.md alternatives added, TASK-026/028 blocked, TASK-049 closed, guardrails added to all 8 open tasks, and prepared_digest fresh), and all 12 open GitHub issues are mapped into TASK-054~057. However, handoff still fails Crux buildability and factual spec integrity on 3 blocking gaps: (1) skeinn task next now returns self-blocked TASK-035 ahead of the P0 frontier, and TASK-035's unblock condition ('golden 捕获迁 /api/utopinn/preview 直采') directly contradicts design/compat-golden-diff.md; (2) newly planned TASK-055 contains two code-level factual errors in its acceptance criteria (confusing /gen's already-wired generateQuiet with /trigger's triggerGeneration, and misstating replaceMvuData as doing path-level schema validation while omitting packages/core/src/mvu/schema.ts), while TASK-054 omits apps/cli/utopinn-cli.mjs and TASK-057 asks for an already-implemented GH#8 test with an unrelated implements anchor; (3) TASK-037 contradicts itself on killed C9 group chat and TASK-044 leaves already-shipped stats/summary and stats/inject as blank open acceptance criteria.

gaps.gap: Unexecutable first task from `skeinn task next` (`TASK-035`) with golden-diff oracle contradiction: `skeinn task next` returns `TASK-035` ahead of the P0 frontier (`TASK-054`~`TASK-056`), yet `TASK-035` itself marks its remaining `done_when`/`acceptance` criteria (`delete /api/chats & /api/backends/chat-completions` and `delete public/scripts/{openai,world-info,PromptManager}.js`) as `未达成(阻塞)` and retains `note: 'status: parked→open(枚举外值修正,parked 语义保留在边界)'`. Worse, `TASK-035` (`acceptance[1]`, `progress.next`) and `.skeinn/design/legacy-convergence.md:146,200-201` state that deleting `3.B` and `public/scripts/*` requires migrating golden capture to `/api/utopinn/preview`, which directly contradicts frozen/current `.skeinn/design/compat-golden-diff.md:10,21-24` (golden-diff compares the original ST browser engine against `@utopinn/core`; `/api/utopinn/preview` IS `@utopinn/core`, so capturing from `/preview` destroys the compatibility oracle). Finally, `TASK-035.outcome` claims '新 SPA 不依赖任何 legacy 端点(已成立)' while `TASK-035.evidence[3]` and `apps/web/src/components/stage/StageFrame.tsx:459,462` show the SPA still calls `/api/quick-replies/list` and `/api/quick-replies/get`.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh Agent running `skeinn task next` is immediately directed to start `TASK-035`, whose `done_when` cannot be completed without either violating `compat-golden-diff.md` and breaking the legacy harness/jest tests, or guessing an unspecified subset of `legacy-convergence.md §5` while ignoring the P0 card-ecosystem bugs (`TASK-054`~`TASK-056`).
gaps.evidence_to_close: Either block/defer the harness-coupled `3.B`/`public/scripts/*` deletion phase of `TASK-035` (or split executable non-blocked cleanup such as `quick-replies` named-doc read endpoint and `jobs` active filter into a scoped task, closing P1+P2 or blocking P3 with real recovery conditions that do NOT claim golden capture can be replaced by `/api/utopinn/preview`), reconcile `legacy-convergence.md:146,200-201` with `compat-golden-diff.md` (golden capture from original ST engine vs frozen snapshots, never core-vs-core), fix `TASK-035.outcome` regarding `/api/quick-replies/*`, and ensure `skeinn task next` returns an immediately executable, uncontradicted active P0 task (e.g., `TASK-054`).

gaps.gap: Code-level factual errors and missing file contracts in newly planned GitHub-issue tasks (`TASK-055`, `TASK-054`, `TASK-057`): (1) `TASK-055` acceptance[1] (`GH#9`) demands wiring `apps/server/src/services/stscript-env.js` `triggerGeneration` '使 /gen slash 命令走真生成链路' — on disk, `/gen` (`packages/core/src/stscript/builtins/messages.ts:389-420`, `generateCallback`) calls `env.host.generateQuiet`, which is ALREADY wired to `runQuietGeneration` in `apps/server/src/services/stscript-env.js:171-195`, whereas `triggerGeneration` (`messages.ts:376-387,989-1006`) is for `/trigger` (main chat generation); (2) `TASK-055` acceptance[2] (`GH#4`) instructs `th.replaceVariables` to run MVU structural schema validation '(对齐 replaceMvuData,失败 400 返具体路径错而不写盘)' — on disk, `apps/server/src/plugins/utopinn-th.js:1376-1383` shows `replaceMvuData` only calls `isMvuData(vars)` (top-level `stat_data`+`schema` presence check) and delegates straight to `replaceVariables`, `packages/core/src/mvu/schema.ts` has no non-mutating path-error validator, and `packages/core/src/mvu/schema.ts` is missing from `TASK-055` `reads`/`touches`; (3) `TASK-054` acceptance[2] (`GH#3`) requires `utopinn doctor` to report card regex status (including `disabledExtensions`) and `verify_by` runs `utopinn-chat-regex.test.mjs` and `utopinn-import.test.mjs`, yet omits `apps/cli/utopinn-cli.mjs` from both `reads` and `touches` (creating uncoordinated overlap with `TASK-057` on `cmdDoctor`) and omits those test files from `touches`; (4) `TASK-057` acceptance[2] (`GH#8`) asks to add a cross-position (`before+after+atDepth`) regression test for `sources.worldInfoActivated === sources.worldInfo.activated.length` in `apps/server/tests/utopinn-generate-context.test.mjs`, which ALREADY exists on disk at lines 170-194 (covering GlobalBook + position 1 after + position 2 AN + position 4 atDepth), and `TASK-057` links `implements` to unrelated `.skeinn/design/cordis-next.md#0. 现状:五张表,五个真相源`.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh Agent executing `TASK-055` will either wire the wrong STscript seam (`triggerGeneration` thinking it powers `/gen`) or try to mirror a nonexistent path-level schema validator in `replaceMvuData` without touching `packages/core/src/mvu/schema.ts`; an Agent on `TASK-054` will have to edit undeclared `apps/cli/utopinn-cli.mjs` (colliding with `TASK-057`); and an Agent on `TASK-057` will be asked to implement an already-present test under an unrelated design anchor.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Correct `TASK-055` acceptance[1] to reflect disk truth (`/gen` already uses `stscript-env.js` `generateQuiet`; clarify whether `/trigger` via `triggerGeneration` is actually in scope or whether `GH#9` scope is strictly `th.generate`/`generateRaw` `lorebookEntries` filtering + `quiet-generation.js` selective WI support); rewrite `TASK-055` acceptance[2] so it specifies creating a real non-mutating MVU schema validator in `packages/core/src/mvu/schema.ts` (added to `reads`/`touches`) used by both `replaceVariables` and `replaceMvuData`, rather than falsely claiming `replaceMvuData` already does path-level validation; add `apps/cli/utopinn-cli.mjs` (or move the `utopinn doctor` regex check into `TASK-057` with explicit ownership) and `utopinn-chat-regex.test.mjs`/`utopinn-import.test.mjs` to `TASK-054` `reads`/`touches`; update `TASK-057` acceptance[2] to acknowledge the existing test at `utopinn-generate-context.test.mjs:170-194` (focusing on any genuinely missing CLI `trace --json` assertion or closing `GH#8` as verified) and fix `TASK-057.implements` to a relevant CLI/client-contract design section or narrow justified `design_exemption`.

gaps.gap: Self-contradictory C9 group-chat wording in `TASK-037`/`legacy-convergence.md` and stale already-shipped scope in `TASK-044`: (1) `TASK-037` repeats in 6 fields (`title`, `outcome`, `done_when[0]`, `acceptance[0]`, `boundaries[0]`, `progress.next`) that '原 group chat C9 已按 DECISIONS.md:274 退役,group 编排已由后续任务承接' — contradicting itself because `DECISIONS.md:274` and `PROJECT.md:13` explicitly KILLED C9 group chat ('砍掉', '不做多人多角色群聊后端') and zero follow-up group-orchestration tasks exist in `.skeinn/tasks.json`; `.skeinn/design/legacy-convergence.md:113,168` similarly still plans `gap#1 群聊域插件化` as a medium-term deliverable; (2) `TASK-044` still carries two blank open acceptance criteria for `GET /api/utopinn/stats/summary` (`acceptance[0]`) and `stats/inject` (`acceptance[1]`) and an `outcome` listing `utopinn-stats` and `ui.contrib manifest`, even though both are ALREADY shipped on disk (`apps/server/src/plugins/utopinn-diag.js:520-669`, `apps/cli/utopinn-cli.mjs:1082,1084,1771,1821`, `apps/web/src/api/stats.ts`, `SpecPanels.tsx:565`, `studio.tsx:210`, confirmed by `plugin-surface-forms.md:52,65` and `PROJECT.md:115`), and `TASK-044` touches `stagepack.tsx`/`StageFrame.tsx` without reading `.skeinn/design/web-rp-form.md` while `progress.completed[1]` still mentions abolished '左右立绘位'.
gaps.why_it_blocks_start: A fresh Agent picking up `TASK-044` sees empty acceptance criteria for `stats/summary` and `stats/inject` and an outcome asking for `utopinn-stats` + `ui.contrib manifest`, risking duplicate work on already-shipped `utopinn-diag` endpoints; an Agent reading `TASK-037` or `legacy-convergence.md` receives contradictory signals on whether group chat is killed or has a follow-up task.
gaps.evidence_to_close: Remove the false 'group 编排已由后续任务承接' wording from `TASK-037` (stating simply that C9 group chat is retired/killed per `DECISIONS.md:274`) and mark `legacy-convergence.md` `gap#1` as retired/compat-only per C9; update `TASK-044` to record verified completion evidence on `acceptance[0]`/`acceptance[1]` (pointing to `utopinn-diag.js:520-669`, `utopinn-cli.mjs`, `apps/web/src/api/stats.ts`) and narrow `outcome` to the actual remaining scope (novel chapters sidecar/range-regen + theater assets/sidecar), add `.skeinn/design/web-rp-form.md` to `TASK-044.reads`, and align `progress.completed[1]` with V2.1 single-portrait ruling.

gaps.gap: Residual `skeinn check` structural warnings and nested `TASK-053` evidence typo: `skeinn check` still emits 7 warnings — 4 historical design docs (`generation-api.md`, `mobile-panels.md`, `perf-budget.md`, `plugin-architecture.md`) still carry core `Kind:` (`contract`/`experience`/`system`) without `## Alternatives considered` despite being marked `partially-stale` or `reference(parked)` in `PROJECT.md`, and `mobile-app-stack/status.json` remains `status: 'provisional'` despite being superseded by D-020 and parked (while `frontend-microkernel` and `storage-engine-semantics` are honestly `provisional` with `source: 'agent'` awaiting human confirmation). gaps.evidence_to_close: Either add concise `## Alternatives considered` notes or reclassify `Kind:` on the 4 stale/parked V1 docs so `skeinn check` has zero core-doc warnings; align `TASK-053.evidence[6].results[0].evidence` in `.skeinn/tasks.json` to `listModels`/`testConnection`; keep `frontend-microkernel` and `storage-engine-semantics` honestly `provisional` until human confirmation (do not forge `source: 'human'`).
